identity.informationGoal: Explain one product through a sequence of readable editorial chapters.
identity.composition: A persistent product subject occupies the foreground while chapter-specific image, color, type, and detail layers move behind and around it.
identity.interaction: Vertical wheel or touch scroll advances a continuous normalized story state. Chapters are state ranges, not isolated pages.
identity.semantic3d: Model rotation, scale, material emphasis, and camera distance reveal the feature discussed by the active chapter.

invariants: The product subject remains visually in front of chapter backgrounds until the contract-defined footer exit.
The subject follows a continuous path across chapter boundaries without teleporting.
Each major 3D state change corresponds to a content claim.
Primary copy remains readable and is never accidentally crossed by the subject.
Mobile uses its own composition and trajectory rather than scaling desktop coordinates.
The document remains navigable and understandable with reduced motion enabled.

stateModel.progress: A clamped value from 0 to 1 derived from document scroll progress.
stateModel.chapters: Ordered, non-overlapping progress ranges with optional blend windows.
stateModel.restore: Refreshing or resizing at mid-page reconstructs the same semantic chapter and visual state.

layers.role: chapter color, image, or video atmosphere
headings, body copy, facts, and controls
navigation, progress, language, and accessibility controls

occlusion.strategy: Each chapter declares protected copy zones and allowed subject zones for desktop and mobile.
occlusion.failure: A required heading, paragraph, control, or the semantic product feature becomes unreadable or invisible.

inputs.wheel: Maps document scroll to continuous progress; no synthetic horizontal wheel capture.
inputs.touch: Uses native vertical page scrolling with momentum.
inputs.pointer: May add bounded parallax but cannot alter the semantic chapter.

responsive.desktop: Product may cross the center line and overlap decorative type while respecting protected copy zones.
responsive.mobile: Product scale and path are reduced, copy order is linearized, and essential content is never placed behind WebGL.
responsive.breakpointPolicy: Interpolate within a layout mode; switch to separately authored states between modes.

reducedMotion.behavior: Replace continuous travel with stable chapter poses and short opacity transitions or a static representative image.
reducedMotion.required: All copy, controls, and product explanations remain available.

exit.behavior: Only after footerStart may the subject fade or move behind the final surface.
